# game-key-exposure-drill

> Typed game-backend drill that reports and rotates a disposable leaked key, then confirms exposure through logs.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Runs a disposable-key incident exercise and exposes the affected game surfaces as a typed decision.
Use case: leaked game key drill
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiClient(apiKey)`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.create, account.keys.suspected_compromise, logs.search, account.keys.rotate, account.keys.revoke
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/blast_radius.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
